{{Quote|Artoo could outperform the entire division, I bet|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Cryptanalysis''' was a branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau]]. Informally known as "'''the Crypt'''," the personnel referred to themselves as [[lignyot]]s, a term which no one else deciphered the meaning of. Cryptanalysis cultivated a reputation for the bizarre; they would send [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]] with simple encryption codes that would produce unflattering holos of the recipient if the code was not broken fast enough. They would also break communications security and forge inflammatory messages between branches. They had a habit of moving the entrance to their offices, or relocating entirely, leaving only a [[Scandoc/Legends|scandoc]] with clues to their new location. Other branches continually complained about Crypt's antics to the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]], but the lignyots defended their behavior by claiming that the time-sensitive nature of their work&mdash;cracking codes and ciphers discovered by [[Media (Imperial Intelligence)|Media]] and [[Signal]]&mdash;entitled them to be a little eccentric. Ubiqtorate, however, saw Crypt's antics as an opportunity, and began to treat each new prank as a problem to be solved as if it were an enemy operation, and would random assign the problem to a different branch to deal with. On one occasion, [[Assassination (Imperial Intelligence)|Assassination]] found and liquidated one of Crypt's installations after they had moved.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] implied that the entire division's ability to decipher codes and ciphers was inferior compared to his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />
